gaps: P0: none; P2: only a map (#9) and a 1726 reissue of an older skyline view (#10, after Witsen); P5: nothing usable (outskirts aerials, a window view, street paintings)
notes: #3: Commons titles it 1556 after Herberstein’s source map, but it is the Braun and Hogenberg vol. 2 plate, so 1575. #34: the watermark sits in the top-left corner; trimming it clips the tip of the bell tower’s cross. If a watermarked source is unacceptable, #37 (Moscow State University, 2024) is the fallback. #12 (1848 Kremlin square) is another option for P3.
